limits: Run 1 failed on the first post-return Retinue proof; its RF miss is retained as a failed experiment, not a successful gate. Runs 2-4 complete; no radio-fault cause established for the first miss.

Cold USB attachment after flash/read/reset sometimes timed out. Explicit DTR assertion followed by deassertion and status retries restored the port. This is a bench recovery receipt, not a general USB attachment fix.
A temporary boot-diagnostic image was installed during attachment investigation; only the final resident ELF is qualified. Complete reserved state was verified unchanged after final installation.

Home-return status samples are later than the requested deadline; they establish automatic return and usable home RF, not exact switching latency. Gap probes witness one unreturned physical home request during an away interval.
Stack usage is sampled at status formatting on the main CPU0 task only; startup, interrupt and between-sample maxima and allocator fragmentation remain unmeasured.
No physical power removal, torn-flash interruption, driver fault injection, adversarial host/RX flood, recurring schedule or authenticated coverage receipt.
Test keys/setup bytes and flash backups remain private. Host packet-counter sync is exercised in ordinary operation, not qualified for a host power cut.
T114 was not flashed and has only live baseline/boot-identity evidence; the third V4 was unused.
